name: Chick-fil-A Waffle Potato Fries (WARNING)
whyItWorks: Large skin-on waffle potatoes deep-fried in canola oil. Contains 24g fat and 5g fiber with tough skin edges that are difficult to chew smooth. High fat delays stomach emptying and triggers rapid gastrocolic dumping.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Avoid during active flares. If in deep remission, eat only 3-4 soft inner wedges and chew thoroughly.
